answer: Farming becomes a delta bet on surviving 89 epochs of grading, and every timber settlement recomputes the spiral schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 89 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 36 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
